integrity: The theorem is proved by an exact reduction of the two bad-unit loci to quadratic-character sums, with all rank and scalar boundary cases treated separately. The source theorem's published corrigendum was inspected and incorporated. Finite enumeration is used only as a consistency check.
limitations: The exact minimum is proved only for odd prime powers and dimension two.
Characteristic two is excluded because the quadratic-character argument degenerates.
The finite checker covers selected prime fields; arbitrary prime powers are handled by the symbolic proof, not by enumeration.
The literature search cannot exclude every unpublished or differently phrased equivalent result.
title: Sharp condition-(Q) witness count in two-dimensional finite-field matrix rings
